decision: Admit preparation of three fixed-budget owner lineages; human gate opens only after actual readiness and native GUI verification.
question: Can four cubic heads add practical value on a preserved trained Q4 basis beyond matched quadratic-head adjustment and ordinary BRE continuation?
rationale: Q4 has a useful development anchor:71.875% versus frozen reference and56.25% versus continued BRE at time; these are not independent strength claims.
Jointly trained C4 does not demonstrate a reliable advantage over adapted Q4 or continued BRE. Throughput and small samples remain confounds.
Fixed heads retain the exact initial Q4 function and restrict new optimization to four coefficients; this tests degree contribution without moving the anchor.

The initial apparent cubic fitting advantage fails the status-valid control. Raw cubic refit results are mixed; loss alone does not settle practical chess value. This is a bounded unresolved hypothesis, not positive expressive-value evidence.
The tiny pilot changed quickly; eight diverse generations are a shorter adaptation/stability test, not an automatic32-generation continuation.
endpointSelection: Latest168 primary selected now before training; Best separately audited, not retrospectively selected from games.
optimizer: Both head variants reset Adam step/moments to zero; original source optimizer preserved. BRE retains exact full Adam.
data: Same inherited source selection/cursors/seek; no data filtering or label/search-policy change. Residual arms share future reservations; BRE historical ranges/split remain distinct.
futureAssessment: Verify all eight generations, immutable frozen prefixes, excluded zero moments, inherited metadata, final steps and Latest/Best.
Compare fixed cubic against fixed quadratic and its exact zero-cubic Q4 anchor; include continued BRE and frozen Gen32 at time, targeted nodes and calibration controls.
Only a candidate with practical degree value merits prespecified independent confirmation on untouched openings. Do not extend unchanged training or matches merely to seek a favorable result.
limitations: No causal proof that shared-embedding interference caused prior results; no matched jointly trained restart in this gate.
Equal nominal settings do not guarantee equal effective optimization or optimized rates.
No independent strength confirmation or successor success.
humanTraining: Reserved to owner; no substantive autonomous training.
